info.name: Lotus Biscoff Cheesecake Dessert Jar
info.description: Crunchy Biscoff biscuit crumbs and luxurious creamy cheese cake are just the perfect combination. The unique caramel notes of the Belgium made Biscoff cookies cut through the richness of cream cheese providing a fragrant, delicious mouthful after taste. The hints of cinnamon and brown sugar are sure to make your mouth water, don't say we didn't warn you!!

info.name: Dutch Truffle Cake Classic 1kg
info.description: This is the Cake that started it all, the signature Dutch Truffle cake is an everyday Chocolate cake made with European pure chocolate which has a very unique balanced roast and flavor. The Truffle flavor has soft and moist cake layers which are not very sweet, allowing the natural roast of the cocoa to shine through. This flavor is a best seller among kids and adults.

info.name: Rainbow Fantasy Pastry
info.description: Rainbow cakes aren’t just insta-worthy, they can be delicious too! Biting into our fluffy rainbow sponge cake will make you feel like you’re munching on a cloud. Topped with lusciously smooth buttercream that’s oh-so-addictive, you won’t be able to stop at just one bite! Slice it to reveal the vivid colours of the rainbow — which are made with natural and preservative-free food colourings.

info.name: Praline Butterscotch Pastry
info.description: If you are a Caramel-y person, this Butterscotch pastry is for you!  A velvety butterscotch cake layered with fresh whipped cream and crunchy cashew nougat. Feel the crunch of nought in every bite

info.name: Flaky Chocolate Surprise Pastry
info.description: The chocolate surprise is an ultimate treat, this vanilla and chocolate pastry is guaranteed to satisfy everybody’s sweet cravings. It has layers of soft chocolate sponge that serve as the ideal bed for pillows of silky-smooth chocolate ganache along with whipped cream and grated chocolate flakes, making it a truly timeless cake. An absolute hit during your celebration.

info.description: Arouse your senses with a velvety bittersweet Belgium chocolate mousse between layers of moist chocolate sponge cake.  The cake is then smothered in decadent chocolate ganache and embellished with chocolate garnishes. One bite and you can’t help closing your eyes and say, “Mmm, so good”!

info.name: Blueberry Baked Cheesecake Pastry
info.description: A classic yet firm Whipped favourite cheesecake. A ten-hour baked cheesecake pastry made with Madagascan vanilla base combined with blueberries in the layers. Topped with blueberry compote and blueberries.

info.name: Classic New York Style Baked Cheesecake Pastry
info.description: Experience the timeless elegance, Hangout’s Classic New York Cheesecake is Rich, creamy, and velvety, this cheesecake is the epitome of indulgence. Crafted to perfection, it's a tribute to the classic New York style, promising a smooth flavour with a slight sweet and tangy after taste

info.name: Lotus Biscoff Baked Cheesecake Pastry
info.description: Cheesecake made the American way and renowned throughout the world, New York Cheesecake is a rich and smooth cheesecake baked to perfection with a bottom cookie crust, that will give you a bursting flavour of mildly sweetened, The base is made out of crushed lotus biscuits and filled with whipped cheesecake batter using Philly cream cheese and lastly a generous drizzle lotus cookie spread topped with lotus biscuit crumble.

info.name: Chocolate Opera Pastry
info.description:
The rich Opera pastry is a musical marriage of two of our favourite flavours ? chocolate and coffee. This luxurious French gateau tastes as delicious as it looks with layers of coffee cream and chocolate ganache sandwiched between coffee syrup-soaked chocolate sponge, which is then coated in a chocolate glaze.
Please note the pastry is not bitter and has a very balanced after taste
A world chocolate month special

info.name: Red Velvet Cupcake (1 Pc)
info.description: For true red velvet fans This best seller in the cup cake category has a Moist red sponge which is topped with our signature silky cream cheese buttercream

info.name: Blueberry Cupcake (1 Pc)
info.description: This light sponge is packed full of delicious blueberry filling. This cupcake is finished off with a buttercream made with natural colourings extracted from fresh blueberries. The vibrant colour and flavour of this cupcake is all natural.

info.name: Oreo Cupcakes (1 Pc)
info.description: This cupcake is fun and brings the Oreo flavours we all love. A timeless choice which has a Chocolate sponge, chocolate ganache centre, Oreo frosting, Oreo cookie and chocolate drizzle.

info.name: Gooey Chocolate Cupcake (1 Pc)
info.description: Fluffy chocolate sponge with a light chocolate ganache frosting, A must for chocolate lovers, our recipe reveals a divine combination of chocolate sponge, topped with an indulgent chocolate cream

info.name: Almond Cookies
info.description: Hangout almond cookies are deliciously fragrant, along with a buttery flavour and are perfectly crisp, with a complete fragrance of almond. Can be paired with some tea, coffee or good conversation.

info.name: Butter Cookies
info.description: [Veg preparation] Butter is the most important ingredient for tenderised baked goods. Hangout's butter cookies are crisps to bite and are specially curated for the Indian palate.

info.name: Garlic Toast
info.description: Our whole wheat garlic toasties are best enjoyed with your tea or coffee. Can also be combined with dips from saucery, now at hangout.

info.name: Glutenfree Lavash
info.description: Gluten free lavash made from the scratch using balanced of jawar flour, ragi flour, oat flour, brown rice flour and potato starch . Crispy, thin and delicious flavoured lavash you can serve with soft cheese or a dip.

info.name: Soup Stick
info.description: Made with whole wheat, our in house perfectly baked, light and crispy soup stick fits well with any soups or can just be dipped in any of the dips from saucery, now at hangout.

info.name: Coconut Cookies
info.description: Made using desiccated coconut. Hangout coconut cookies are full of flavour and can be enjoyed during the monsoon with a cup of hot coffee or tea.

info.name: Multigrain Bread
info.description: Our multigrain bread is made using the finest ingredients without any preservatives. The bread includes a nutritional mix of whole grain added with seeds throughout the dough and not just for garnish. The bread is 100 % veg.

info.name: Dalia Bread
info.description: Dalhia is the hindi term for broken cereals, hangout's dalhia bread is a healthy alternative for the regular white loaf.

info.name: French Baguette
info.description: Crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, its great for a crusty sandwich and a perfect complement a soup.

info.name: Garlic Bread
info.description: Best enjoyed when sliced with cheese spread.

info.name: Oats Bread
info.description: Baked with premium oats giving a soft and chewy feel. The bread is deliciously moist.

info.name: Lava Chocolate Cake
info.description: Gooey Chocolate Lava cake With a moist center of luxury chocolate ganache with creamy and chocolatey melted center, a decadent sinful dessert that is rich in flavour and sweetness  perfectly portioned to bring any meal to a satisfying conclusion.

info.name: Assorted Chocolate Box ( Gold)
info.description: Thoughtfully curated boxes designed to for Bulk Gifting or Bundle Gifting.  This box  includes Moulded Chocolates. The shelf life of this hamper is 40 days

info.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
info.description: Gooey Chocolate Lava cake With a moist center of luxury chocolate ganache with creamy and chocolatey melted center, a decadent sinful dessert that is rich in flavour and sweetness  perfectly portioned to bring any meal to a satisfying conclusion.

info.name: Eggless Walnut Brownie
info.description: A sublime symphony of warm chocolate fudge and crunchy walnuts, this old-fashioned chocolate walnut brownie adds a touch of nostalgia to your dessert table. Our chocolate and walnut brownies are so tempting you’ll want to devour them morning, noon, and night!

info.name: Eggless Hazelnut Brownie
info.description: Our chocolate hazelnut brownies are super fudgy and rich from a blend of dark and semisweet chocolate. Roasted hazelnuts provide the crunch and pair so well with chocolate for a favourite flavor combo

info.name: Sugar Free Brownie
info.description: Nobody can resist a chocolatey treat, right? Our no added sugar brownie will never fail to send your taste buds on a flavorful journey! Every bite you take will be bursting with flavours The brownie is specially curated keeping in mind people who are off sugar
